hash_basis: bytes as stored in the repository; text files have LF line endings there, and a checkout with core.autocrlf may show them with CRLF
why_not_certified: No Android device evidence for any card (M7.2 open).
Presentation (scan-out) latency is not observed anywhere (M1.2).
Renderer-only soaks do not certify full application and Android lifecycle profiles (M7.1/M7.2).
Operational independent-provider failover remains unverified; loopback continuation is not certification (M1.3).
Several workflows are shown by unit tests and offscreen captures only, not interactive walkthroughs.

cards.title: Reconcile and maintain the evidence baseline
cards.status_line: implementation: documented in this roadmap; verification: static audit complete, runtime certification open. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §§0, 7, 8; ROADMAP_NEW §§22, 29, 30.

cards.title: Make domain ownership testable
cards.status_line: implementation: implemented (initial ownership seams); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §7; ROADMAP_NEW §2.1.

cards.title: Pin the scientific and visual corpus
cards.status_line: implementation: implemented (increments 1–5 delivered); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §8; ROADMAP_NEW §§K2, K3, 25.

cards.title: Carry temporal coverage into every radar representation
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (derived/3D coverage, accepted receipts, native pass history and source sequence receipts); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §§1.2, 9, 10; ROADMAP_NEW §§B2, B5, H8.

cards.title: Trace receipt through completed rendering
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (GPU-completion stage, increment 1); verification: partial (software GPU only).

cards.title: Prove source failover under severe-weather load
Complete retained provenance and scientific lineage
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (source clocks; Tornado ID lineage); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §§9, 10; ROADMAP_NEW §§A1, A2, N1, N2.

cards.title: Introduce persistent storm identity and history
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (domain history owner); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_2 §2.1; ROADMAP_NEW §§R3, R4, R5.

cards.title: Unify storm selection, trends, and tool entry
Extend impacts to geolocated communities and assets
Certify editing and preserve historical manual work
Expose authoritative gate metadata
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (decoded Nyquist and unambiguous range, increment 1; decoded Nyquist in dealiasing, increment 2); verification: partial (independent byte-level read; Py-ART 2.3.0 comparison on 12 cached volumes).

cards.title: Complete portable, validated product definitions
Render and export column-based products
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (column fields on the map, increment 1); verification: partial (unit, real-volume CPU, software-GPU; no physical device).

cards.title: Preserve physical extrema while aging trails
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (polar trail layer wired to the exact sliding window, increment 2); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_NEW §C2; ROADMAP_2 §§8, 15.2.

cards.title: Add translucent volume rendering and richer surfaces
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (front-to-back compositing and gradient lighting, increment 1); verification: partial (CPU opacity references; software-GPU frames; no physical device or real-volume capture).

cards.title: Link storm-centered 3D, slices, and measurement
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (direct cross-section editing and 3D cut link, increment 1); verification: partial (geometry unit tests; no device interaction).

cards.title: Introduce independent GIS layers and groups
Complete native imports with shapefile bundles
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (zipped bundles; whole-bundle and stored-entry bounds); verification: partial. **Original references:** ROADMAP_NEW §§I1, I2, I3, Q1; ROADMAP_2 §5.1.

cards.title: Finish styling, feature inspection, and filtering
Restore and exchange GIS scenes reliably
Support independent link groups and source contexts
Add satellite-native one-minute playback
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (satellite-driven loop over native scan listings, increment 1); verification: partial (unit; live NOAA listing; no interactive or device run).

cards.title: Broaden field inspection within supported models
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (regional inventory discovery and a discovered-field layer, increment 1; GFS, increment 2; browsed winds as barbs, increment 5; ECMWF, increment 6); verification: partial (unit on real `.idx` lines; live HRRR inventory and field; no interactive or device run).

cards.title: Unify rendering quality, labels, and transitions
Separate preview from program output
Persist complete, validated scenes
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (versioned product and time policy, increment 1); verification: partial (unit; no capture walkthrough).

cards.title: Harden deterministic capture and archive output
cards.status_line: implementation: in progress (capture manifest, increment 1); verification: partial (unit; no repeat-run or sustained capture).
